body.cap: MTSCompany showcased its cancer pathology diagnostic platform, AI-ALPA, at the global media event CES Unveiled ahead of CES 2025's official opening. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: MTSCompany Co., Ltd. (CEO Heewon Chung) participated in CES Unveiled, a pre-CES 2025 event held on January 5th (local time) in the United States. Founded in 2015, the company has built a strong reputation for developing next-generation ICT solutions, responding agilely to technological trends of the Fourth Industrial Revolution, and reinforcing its AI-based research and development capabilities.

MTSCompany has previously introduced AI solutions that efficiently analyze and process real-time and high-capacity big data in online and server environments. This expertise has allowed the company to expand its influence in the domestic business messaging industry while exploring applications of its technology in new fields.

As part of its strategic expansion, MTS Company developed the AI-ALPA cancer pathology diagnostic platform, which was unveiled at CES 2025. The platform analyzes cells and tissue captured in pathology images with AI technology, identifying biomarkers for cancer diagnosis. AI-ALPA predicts lymph node metastasis and genetic test results by integrating pathology image data with clinical information, offering unique diagnostic capabilities.
AI-ALPA automates complex pathology processes while delivering over 90% accuracy, enabling precise and timely diagnoses and supporting efficient treatment planning.

body.cap: Jangwon Seo, team lead at MTSCompany, introduces AI-ALPA at CES 2025 Unveiled. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Additionally, the company presented a mobile application for cervical cancer diagnosis, which significantly enhances access to high-quality medical services. The app uses AI to analyze cervical images captured on mobile devices, initially assessing cervical conditions. A gynecologist then reviews the results for a final diagnosis. The app also identifies biopsy sites to improve sampling accuracy, reducing the likelihood of misdiagnoses.

MTSCompany states, “Real-time AI diagnostic solutions like AI-ALPA play a vital role in delivering advanced healthcare services to regions with limited medical infrastructure. Furthermore, the platform ensures accurate sampling during biopsies, significantly lowering the risk of diagnostic errors.”

The company plans to develop its AI technology further to analyze and process digital pathology data and build diagnostic platforms capable of addressing cellular and genetic levels. MTSCompany also aims to keep pace with advances in digital imaging devices, offering AI solutions with enhanced accuracy and speed.

MTSCompany participated in CES 2025 as part of the Seoul Pavilion in Eureka Park, the startup-focused exhibition area. The Seoul Pavilion, expanded by over 50% from the previous year to 1,040 square meters, features 104 startups. It represents a collaboration between three Seoul districts (Gangnam, Geumcheon, and Gwanak), five startup support organizations (SBA, Seoul Tourism Organization, Seoul Bio Hub, Seoul AI Hub, and Campus Town Growth Center), and eight universities (Konkuk, Kyung Hee, Kookmin, Dongguk, Sogang, Seoul National University of Science and Technology, Yonsei, and Chung-Ang).
AVING News, which has covered CES for 20 consecutive years, continues to support the global ambitions of Korean SMEs and startups through various initiatives.

Before CES 2025, AVING hosted a series of Global Media Meetups featuring aspiring SMEs in Korea. The Meetups introduced Korean SMEs’ technologies, products, and services to media worldwide, expanding connections between the Korean industry and global media. Geekspin, Ubergizmo, Interesting Engineering, and Le Café du Geek participated in these meetups.
During CES 2025, AVING established the AVING Broadcasting Zone at The Venetian Hotel in Las Vegas, interviewing CES Innovation Award 2025 winners.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host a review conference with participating companies in Korea, offering them a platform to gain further recognition and enhance their corporate image.
